description: One polyphonic input taken apart into sixteen jacks, in 4HP, either one channel per jack or in slices

params.text: Chooses how the outputs are filled: Mono gives each jack one channel of the input, Poly gives each patched jack the run of channels up to it

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal being taken apart

outputs.text: Carries the channel of the input with the same number in Mono mode, or a slice of channels ending at that number in Poly mode; 0V where the input has no such channel

notes: in Poly mode only the patched jacks matter: patching jacks 8 and 16 of a sixteen-channel input gives two eight-channel signals
a light beside a jack is green when the input has that channel, red when the jack is in use but the input runs out, and dark otherwise
menu: Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
